login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Your reviews are waiting — pick up right where you left off.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Please check your credentials.

oidcErrors.account_disabled: Your account is disabled. Please contact an administrator.
oidcErrors.email_missing: The identity provider did not share an email address, which qnop requires for an account.
oidcErrors.oidc: Sign-in via the identity provider failed. Please try again or contact an administrator.

register.title: Create your reviewer profile
register.subtitle: Two minutes to set up — your first review is waiting.
register.terms: I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy (GDPR).
register.failed: Registration failed. Please try again later.
register.doneSubtitle: One click left before your first review.
register.doneMessage: If the details are valid, we've sent you a confirmation email. Confirm your address to activate your reviewer profile.

forgotPassword.title: Locked out? It happens.
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a secure link to get back to your reviews.
forgotPassword.done: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way — check your inbox.
forgotPassword.failed: Request failed. Please try again later.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Strong and memorable — your reviews are waiting.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or incomplete. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.invalidLinkNoReset: This link is invalid or incomplete, and this deployment does not offer self-service password reset. An administrator can set a new password for you.
resetPassword.failed: Reset failed. Please request a new link.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forcedSubtitle: For your security, choose a fresh password before diving in.
changePassword.done: Your password has been changed. Please sign in with the new password.
changePassword.generatedHint: Save this somewhere safe — it now fills the new-password fields.
changePassword.failed: The current password is wrong, or the new password does not meet the requirements.

verifyEmail.title: Verify email
verifyEmail.success: Your email address is confirmed — your reviewer profile is ready. You can sign in now.
verifyEmail.error: The confirmation link is invalid or expired.

brand.headline: Reviews your team actually wants to finish.
brand.body: Annotate, discuss and approve documents together — with streaks, scoreboards and profiles that celebrate every closed review. And your data stays under your control — wherever qnop runs.
